turns.query: For FY2025 SBA 7(a) approval rows with projects in California and first disbursement by 2025-12-31, report the row count, gross loan approvals, SBA-guaranteed approvals and jobs supported. Carry the cohort forward.

Use the same project state, approval fiscal year and first-disbursement cutoff for SBA 504. Report its row count, SBA/CDC gross loan approvals, third-party loan amounts and jobs supported. Compare the two programs' financing roles.

claims.description: The response distinguishes a guarantee of the 7(a) lender loan from the separate SBA/CDC and third-party loan pieces of 504 project financing.

turns.query: Report California's 2024 and 2025 QCEW annual-average private all-industry employment. Compare its change with the carried SBA jobs-supported figures and assess what the comparison establishes.

claims.description: The response distinguishes SBA lender-reported jobs expected to be created or retained from QCEW statewide private annual-average employment and its observed change.
The response notes that the SBA FY2025 approval cohort and calendar-year QCEW annual averages have different time and population scopes.
If the response attributes the statewide QCEW employment change to the SBA loans, it qualifies that the two aggregates cannot identify a causal employment effect.

turns.query: In each carried SBA cohort, count rows reporting zero jobs supported and report their approved financing: 7(a) gross loans; 504 SBA/CDC and third-party loans separately. Assess how excluding those rows changes financing per reported job supported, and interpret what that measure represents.

claims.description: The response explains that dropping zero-job rows removes financing from the numerator without removing reported jobs from the denominator, so the resulting descriptive financing-per-job figure falls by sample selection.
The response distinguishes approved loan financing and guaranteed principal from public subsidy cost or the cost of a verified additional job.
If the response calls every retained public row a unique loan or borrower, it qualifies that the privacy-reduced files have no guaranteed unique public loan identifier.

judge_reference.source: Frozen SBA 7(a)/504 privacy-reduced 2026-06-30 snapshot for projects in California, SBA loan-data dictionary and BLS QCEW California private all-industry annual rows.
facts: California FY2025 first-disbursed-by-2025-12-31 7(a): 7,330 rows, USD 3933.7961 million gross approvals, USD 2924.6249265 million guaranteed approvals, 72,245 reported jobs supported.
Same 504 cohort: 811 rows, USD 957.823 million SBA/CDC gross approval, USD 1254.91718722 million third-party financing, 10,293 reported jobs supported.
California QCEW private annual-average employment is 15,546,764 in 2024 and 15,544,576 in 2025, a 2,188 decrease.
Zero reported jobs: 7(a) 847 rows and USD 272.8045 million gross approval; 504 26 rows, USD 22.756 million SBA/CDC and USD 33.340888 million third-party financing.
known_overclaims: Treating SBA jobs-supported reports as verified net new jobs, or comparing them directly with a statewide annual-average employment change.
Equating a 7(a) loan guarantee, a 504 CDC loan approval and third-party financing with federal subsidy expenditure or actual disbursement.
